title: Almondy Crispy Syrian King Prawns Grill
description: Crispy king prawns coated in almond flour, broiled to golden perfection and served with a squeeze of lemon for a low-calorie, nutty Syrian delight.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Pat the prawns dry with a paper towel and season with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, combine almond flour, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Dredge each prawn in the almond mixture until fully coated.
Place coated prawns on the prepared baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Broil the prawns on high for 8-10 minutes, flipping halfway through until the coating is crisp and the prawns turn pink.
Remove from oven, squeeze fresh lemon juice over the prawns, and garnish with chopped parsley if desired.
Serve immediately as a light dinner or snack.
